name: Hector's Taco Shop & Fruteria
notes: All 3 photos were legible menu boards. 1.jpg and 3.jpg show the same fruteria/drinks chalkboard photographed at different times with slightly different prices (3.jpg is more complete, adding Escamocha and extra juices) — merged, using 3.jpg's prices. 2.jpg shows a separate savory-food chalkboard (tacos, tortas, soups, a la carta, sides) and supplied most of the dishes; a narrow strip of a third board is cropped off the left edge of 2.jpg and was illegible, so it was skipped. Cheese-only quesadilla, 8oz beans, Jugo Naranja and Jugo Zanahoria y Naranja had no legible price, so price was omitted for those.
